SUMMARY.md:
> Public read-only data from claude-resets.com, which tracks Claude Code usage-limit reset announcements by @ClaudeDevs and Claude Code team members, plus limit-policy changes, alongside OpenAI Codex resets taken from codex-resets.com. No key. Data is CC BY 4.0 with credit to claude-resets.com; quoted post text belongs to its author.
>
> Sources: https://claude-resets.com/llms.txt (which documents the dataset contract), with all three JSON endpoints probed live on 2026-10-23.
>
> Not modelled: the RSS feeds (/rss.xml, /rss/resets.xml), the iCalendar feed (/calendar.ics), the monthly CSV, the MCP server (/mcp) and /api/statusline (text/plain key=value lines), none of which is JSON. Observed differences between the live catalog and the static dataset: the live catalog adds `meta` and a `verification` field on every event, gives every Codex event a `resetType` (regular or banked), and may list upstream or provisional events the static file does not yet hold (65 Codex events live vs 59 static on the probe date). Unverified: events with verification `provisional` (none existed on the probe date), and non-empty provisional id lists.
Deadline to apply it, or null when none was set.
